#### Brief description of what is fixed or changed

The following failure can be averted by letting the uncertainty in the error be up to 2 ULP (units in last place); the current requirements make it about 1.61 ULP for the failing test. This is only changing the test criteria.

```
=============================================== short test summary info ===============================================
FAILED sympy/codegen/tests/test_algorithms.py::test_newtons_method_function__rtol_cse_nan - assert 2.86126401550282484098850784656751e-15 < 2.64523030128337532347187054305861e-15
================================== 1 failed, 2 passed, 2 skipped, 1 xfailed in 1.07s ==================================
```

commits.author: Christopher Smith
commits.message: Allow two ULPs for Newton root accuracy on different platforms

diff:
diff --git a/sympy/codegen/tests/test_algorithms.py b/sympy/codegen/tests/test_algorithms.py
index d9ee656b49c7..1d6e57094391 100644
--- a/sympy/codegen/tests/test_algorithms.py
+++ b/sympy/codegen/tests/test_algorithms.py
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 from __future__ import annotations
+from math import ulp
 import tempfile
 from sympy import log, Min, Max, sqrt
 from sympy.core.numbers import Float
@@ -178,4 +179,5 @@ def _clamp(low, expr, high):
             req = ref*reftol[meth]
             if use_cse:
                 req *= 2
-            assert abs(result - ref) < req
+            # Allow for floating-point resolution differences across platforms.
+            assert abs(result - ref) < max(req, 2*ulp(result))
